children: STOXX FLAT AS TECH REBOUND MEETS COMMODITY DRAG

A bounce in tech was not enough to lift European equities firmly into positive territory in early trading on Wednesday, with mining and other basic resources (.SXPP) shares sliding to eight-month lows and weighing on the STOXX 600 after heavy losses in the previous session.
was last unchanged, as a 1.3% surge in tech (.SX8P) following reassuring Nvidia
earnings were offset by weakness across the commodities complex (.SXPP), (.SXEP), hit by falling oil and metal prices.
Healthcare (.SXDP) stocks also lent support, while banks edged lower (.SX7P).
